newsitem.title: JAPAN: North Japan test well yields crude and natural gas.
newsitem.headline: North Japan test well yields crude and natural gas.

text.p: Japan Petroleum Exploration Co Ltd (JAPEX), a semi-governmental firm, said on Thursday that a test well in Akita prefecture, northern Japan, had yielded crude oil and natural gas.

The Minami Ayukawa AK-1 well in the Yurihara field was drilled to a depth of 2,553 metres and tested in five locations, JAPEX said in a statement. Three of the tests succeeded in drawing crude and natural gas, it said.
The first test yielded 10,000 cubic metres of natural gas per day and 62 kilolitres (kl) of crude per day.
The second test produced 28,000 cubic metres per day of natural gas and 165 kl per day of crude.
Natural gas flowed at 1,000 cubic metres per day and crude oil at four kl per day in the fifth test, JAPEX said.
Exploration in the area will continue, JAPEX said.
